priority_definitions.P1: Fix before the stated affected pilot/upgrade use
priority_definitions.P2: Bounded correctness, reporting or usability repair

findings.title: Expanded-form generator crashes on equal digits
findings.observed: Seed 1529 generates 7777; every digit swap preserves the value, find returns undefined, and destructuring throws. A 100000-seed probe found 34 crashes. Production map navigation reproduced the TypeError.
findings.minimum_correction: Guarantee a valid non-equivalent distractor fallback and explicitly test equal-digit boundaries 1111 through 9999. Preserve the old seed 127 fix.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Numerically valid alternatives are rejected
findings.observed: M-TH-08 seed 27 offers 4:2 and 4−2 for half of 4; seed 64 offers 3×6 and 2×3+2×6 for 18 cells. The alternate correct numerical result is rejected by both checker and actual lesson UI.
findings.minimum_correction: Prevent numeric collisions, accept justified alternatives, or explicitly ask for structural modeling with truthful feedback about numerical equivalence.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Novice duration and motion teaching remains static-first
findings.observed: All 21 mapped demos are unchanged and have zero shared-player steps. Random simulation shares do not guarantee an experiential introduction. Static-only M-TIME-03 completion and a static-only guided propeller grant were reproduced.
findings.minimum_correction: Author explicit novice event/replay/explanation/practice sequences with meaningful family tags; preserve direct expert entry and purposeful later static tasks. Repair retained incompatible graph pairs and retrieval dispatch.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Oval geometry and run ending misrepresent the asked journey
findings.observed: Equal model lap quarters render as 107.2 px and 165.886 px, causing apparent speed changes. No separate cumulative-distance ruler is rendered. All3/6-lap SPEED-MIXED scenarios stop at60s although their correct durations are120–300s.
findings.minimum_correction: Use actual drawn arc-length parameterization, add unrolled cumulative distance and show a physically complete asked journey or an explicitly partial preview with a correct full-journey representation.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Notebook saves an unperformed trial and immediately shows stale state
findings.observed: Choosing 4 m/s and recording at 0 s saves20m/5s before Start. Immediate notebook says no runs because it uses stale game state. Navigation/reload reveals the fabricated result. No KC attempt is minted by this record.

reproduction.path: installed chassis -> test track ->4m/s -> record without Start

findings.minimum_correction: Save actual completed trial snapshots. Label predictions separately. Prevent never-started/partial/reset runs from masquerading as observations and refresh notebook immediately.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Recognition-only paths still earn production claims
findings.observed: Six strengthened KCs can reach checked without their production family. family.limit is not consumed by evidence derivation or adult/export outcomes. Expression formation can award writing ability after four multiple choices.
findings.minimum_correction: Require a relevant bounded production check before the production claim, or expose the narrower observed outcome in reward, adult summary and export. Preserve lightweight progression and raw attempts.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Zero-warning family coverage misses real demands
findings.observed: Coordinate plotting is undeclared in a symmetry transfer; a centimetre factor only in post-answer feedback is marked supplied; division/unit demand detection misses120:60. Broad prefix matching and unrelated supplied strings can falsely clear requirements.
findings.minimum_correction: Use explicit instance/domain contracts, before-answer supplied facts, demonstrated outcomes and relevant in-scope support. Distinguish context_knowledge from co-taught. Supplement contracts with detectors; report detector output separately from semantic coverage.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: First migration loses old possessions from expanded chapters
findings.observed: The old177 eligible prize is recalculated using new181 chapter membership. Completed mitat, veistamo and piirakka prizes disappear when new KCs are unknown. Raw attempts remain; persisted181 parts were not lost in this probe.

reproduction.fixture: all old chapter members checked; no game field

findings.minimum_correction: Snapshot historical ownership under the old eligibility contract. Preserve assisted historical progress distinctly. Do not invent new mission or KC evidence.

findings.title: Adult success ratio mixes neutral process omissions and familiar replay
findings.observed: Actual counting UI with two earlier independent successes, one neutral correct-total/process-incomplete response and its familiar retry displays3/4 independent. Engine streak correctly stays2.
findings.minimum_correction: Aggregate fresh assessment separately from process-incomplete and familiar replay attempts.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Assisted mission completion may be labelled direct
findings.observed: Historical checked direct KC plus any correct current non-replay attempt can classify a guided demo/hint success as direct after quick failures.

during_mission: guided correct with demo and hint

findings.minimum_correction: Record the actual route and help used in the current mission while retaining the same appropriate reward.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Tester deferral events use the real learner stream
findings.observed: Synthetic deferral is ignored by store.deferred; a real deferral leaks into tester recommendations. Real attempts are not overwritten.
findings.minimum_correction: Apply the active real/test stream predicate to events as well as attempts.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Direct workshop entry omits storage notices
findings.observed: The map/adult flow warns about nonpersistent or repaired storage; the new workshop shell only renders its tester notice. Implementation report already acknowledges this.
findings.minimum_correction: Reuse the common storage notice on workshop/relevant game surfaces; make backup wording conditional on actual backup success.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Arrival-time domain exceeds basic-clock support and has invalid distractors
findings.observed: TIME02 teaches00/30 minutes with hours1–12. UNIT05 arrival transfer uses35/40/45/50-minute starts, rollover and hours up to15. Both wrong options always have invalid minutes65–95. UNIT05 has one relevant rollover demo, so the context is not wholly untaught.
findings.minimum_correction: Teach and declare the bounded actual clock context; use plausible valid clock-time distractors. No additional canonical time KC was established as necessary.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: Separate SVG scaling weakens the intended size comparison
findings.observed: Nominal32/44/56 shapes are independently normalized to width100%. At390 and 1280px, each SVG renders300px tall on its own row. The contrast is largely normalized and requires scrolling; shapes are not literally identical in visible size.
findings.minimum_correction: Use a shared reference coordinate system/scale for the compared shapes, with all relevant examples visible together where practical.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path

findings.title: A drive-to-check-time task lacks a time instrument
findings.observed: The SPEED-REARR simulation asks the learner to check by driving but shows only track/ruler/speedometer, without a stopwatch or timeline. Its arithmetic remains answerable.
findings.minimum_correction: Provide a usable time readout/reveal for the promised verification, optionally after the prediction.
findings.gate: Before the relevant pedagogical pilot path
